name: recurrence-maturity-depth
preparation_scope: Only source/test definitions, documents and small reference metadata. This file does not authorize tests, array reads, model forwards, GPU work, training or global-memory mutation.
execution_prerequisites: Root explicitly authorizes execution after N closeout; N frozen four-run protocol remains unchanged.
Root freezes final source/config/19-class feature-map/input identity closure, CPU fixture limits and phase runtime limits before any relevant execution.
Use existing A completed audit and independent review; no new tool candidate/handoff or repeat A sample audit.
CPU initialization/short and empty history tests and four two-step real smokes are the proposed admission path; an extra native CUDA stage matrix is not budgeted.
question: Under common strict historical support, does conservative masking of immature cart/fav/buy window labels change independently trained R2-minus-R1 predictive benefit, including task heterogeneity?

formulas: Apply the original single final post attention/norm/FFN and four complete original towers at the chosen depth.
model_contract.optimizer_trajectory_equality: not asserted, within the four cells or versus historical models
model_contract.parameter_count_status: formula prediction only; root must verify actual 19-class constructor counts before freeze/admission

loader_contract.target_timestamp: full_timestamp_seq[l] inferred from matching user_info row
loader_contract.same_second: exclude entire token in both modes
loader_contract.future_history: exclude entire token in both modes; report separately
loader_contract.masked_history_fields: all item_dict history fields zero; common history mask zero
loader_contract.positions: native cumsum(valid_mask)-1 convention after common masking
loader_contract.target_rows_and_seq_len: never filter/reindex target rows or rewrite seq_len
loader_contract.released: retain original action combination on common valid history
loader_contract.mature: retain original combination only if history_timestamp+86400<target_timestamp; otherwise hide BOTH positive and zero cart/fav/buy, retaining click only under its explicit availability assumption
loader_contract.unknown_semantics: cart/fav/buy unavailable, not mature negative, exposure or padding; action embedding must use 17/18
loader_contract.unknown_task_masks: zero means no observed positive in the helper mask, not known negative; original QFormer consumes actual action embedding
loader_contract.click_availability: conditional assumption; no independent click-event or ingestion timestamp
loader_contract.original_release_files: read-only; create a separate derived feature map/metadata identity, never relabel original files
loader_contract.audit: mode-independent ordered row/batch identity, mode-specific transformed-input identity, exclusions/unknown counts, valid-length/empty counts, source checks and side-cache read counts/costs; reconcile all four runs without a separate broad scan

training_budget.batch_order: preserve original loader streams and compare ordered row/batch fingerprints across all four runs; no additional shuffle seed
training_budget.checkpoint_selection: same original save_best_only / eval_steps / macro AUC monitor for every cell; full 2193 updates required
training_budget.training_compute_scope: fixed data/update budget, not equal FLOPs between R1 and R2

statistics.effect_coefficients_apply_to: all model metrics computed on the same observed rows or the same resampled user multiplicities
statistics.macro_definition: equal-weight mean of the four AUCs; no new macro-BCE selection objective
statistics.resampling: accepted original user bootstrap and AUC implementation; retain identical sorted user order, row identity and multiplicities for all four models
statistics.bce_definition: original prediction-dtype epsilon clipping then float64 log/log1p; each draw uses actual resampled-row denominator
statistics.interaction_interval: compute I inside each shared draw; never subtract endpoints of marginal confidence intervals
statistics.interval: 95% percentile, exploratory conditional on these four selected checkpoints; no training-seed, multiplicity or selection correction
statistics.save: four-model observed metrics and common draw identity; per-effect 500x21 derived draw arrays, source/row/user/input hashes and points/intervals; derived task differences require no extra sampling

latency.raw_batch: same first 1024 validation rows without filtering, fixed raw row/label/history identity
latency.input_binding: released R1/R2 share byte-identical released input; mature R1/R2 share byte-identical mature input. Cross-mode action tensors differ by design and are not claimed identical.
latency.device: one same exclusively verified physical GPU, BF16 autocast, same batch shapes and event timing
latency.data_cost: record raw decode, timestamp lookup and each mode conversion separately with CPU/wall/RSS/cache/read counters; conversion is excluded from model-only CUDA events and not represented as full deployment throughput
latency.memory: report each model allocated/reserved peak VRAM and input bytes, plus transformation/side-cache CPU peak RSS; do not infer from +32 parameter count
latency.selection_use: resource description of the matched factorial, not new benchmark selection or old-incumbent promotion

additional_original_array_audits.scope: reuse saved A evidence; new loader checks occur within later explicitly authorized smokes/training. Any separate unresolved data check requires a bounded row/column/rowgroup plan and root authorization before reads.

smoke_and_formal.notes: 2193/2-step logical caps above are fixed; root must bind final time/memory caps and no-automatic-retry policy before launching.

paired_analysis.notes: one shared 500-draw run; runtime and input-hashing budgets must be frozen before reading prediction arrays.

latency_and_conversion.notes: four checkpoints only; no conversion microbenchmark repetition or extra model calibration implicitly authorized.

interpretation.primary: Assess D_mature and I jointly, with all tasks and direct task-effect differences. Significant versus nonsignificant marginal intervals do not establish task heterogeneity.
interpretation.remaining_benefit: positive D_mature AUC evidence can support remaining predictive benefit under this conservative input protocol; negative I can coexist with positive D_mature.
not_identified: fraction of historical AUC caused by leakage
same-second exclusion effect separated from the common strict support
exact actual future-event or ingestion availability
literal new external information or a specific attention mechanism
online causal benefit or complete leakage removal
interpretation.near_zero: CI crossing zero is not equivalence or proof of no information; no only-one-task conclusion
interpretation.conservative_masking: can hide positives already observed before target time; changes representation and training/gradient/optimizer trajectory
interpretation.incumbent: No automatic promotion, old-score replacement or prior-protocol near-candidate policy; four new released/mature scores answer this matched input-protocol question
interpretation.missing_or_failure: retain terminal failure/partial artifacts and costs; no fabricated AUC, no silent row exclusion, no automatic added seed/run

reference_scope: Small source/config/manifest/result/metadata identities read for provenance only; no datasets, checkpoints or prediction arrays were read or rehashed for this draft. Source owners are still preparing B files; their final identities are intentionally not frozen here.
